 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Buffaloes enter the matchup at 4-6 following an impressive 42-32 upset of No. 14 Houston last weekend. Head coach Deion Sanders saw his team deliver one of its best offensive performances of the season, rushing for 249 yards and five touchdowns. Quarterback Isaac Wilson threw for 217 yards and a touchdown, while running back Richard Young added 99 rushing yards and two scores. Colorado will need another strong performance to keep its postseason hopes alive.

The Bearcats have dropped three consecutive games but remain dangerous offensively, particularly behind running back Cole Tabb, who has rushed for 977 yards and 10 touchdowns this season. Quarterback JC French IV has also thrown for more than 2,000 yards, giving Cincinnati a balanced offensive attack. Kickoff is scheduled for 12:00 PM ET on ESPN+.
